review_evidence: README describes importGraph as a tool for creating import graphs of Lake packages and related import-analysis utilities.

Complete scan of 37 Lean files found production modules for environment/module dependency analysis, graph filtering/export, LSP widgets, redundant/unused-import detection, and CLI commands, with no production theorem or lemma declarations.

The only two theorem declarations are ImportGraphTest/ToTarget.lean:fancy and ImportGraphTest/WithSorry/Thm.lean:bad_contains_sorry, deliberately tiny fixtures for dependency/sorry analysis rather than independent mathematical results.

source_action.content_invariant: Production code implements import/environment graph algorithms, exports, editor tools, and CLI behavior with no theorem/lemma proof development; the two theorem declarations are test fixtures, so retirement hides no unique mathematical statement, proof, specification, or verified semantics.
